name: Seymour Centre Student Rush for University of Sydney students
summary: Heavily discounted last-minute theatre tickets emailed to University of Sydney students who sign up to the Seymour Student Rush.
who: Current University of Sydney students registered with their University email address.
how: Sign up through the Student Rush form; offers are emailed as they become available.
catches: Offers can be on the day of the performance or a few days before.

source.label: Seymour Centre: University of Sydney Students

evidence.quote: Our Student Rush Program aims to provide heavily discounted tickets for University of Sydney students.
The Seymour Student Rush is only available for University of Sydney students with a valid University of Sydney email address.
